rationale: The trade has effectively reached its target — price at $12.09 sits just above the $12.06 take-profit and only 0.5% above the $12.03 session low, leaving at most ~$20-40 of remaining reward against a ~$200 giveback if the anticipated bounce off the low reaches the 9-EMA at $12.41. With no new headlines and no absorption or reversal signal, a flip to long has no mechanical support any more than it did at entry, so there is nothing stronger than simply taking the profit. Closing locks in +$155.52 (~1.3R) on a thesis that played out, rather than holding short into a support retest at 3.5% of the daily range.
